basic.name: Cat Got Your Flametongue?
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy.

variants.name: Bloom! Winner Takes All
variants.description_template: Finalizes the livestream. Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Sparxie's ATK to adjacent targets.

skill.name: Boom! Sparxicle's Poppin'
skill.description: Start a livestream to turn Basic ATK into "Bloom! Winner Takes All" and trigger "Engagement Farming" 1 time. During this ability, "Engagement Farming" can be triggered repeatedly, up to 20 time(s). Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.

variants.name: Engagement Farming
variants.description_template:
Causes "Bloom! Winner Takes All" to increase the DMG multiplier against one designated enemy by {{scaling1}}% and the DMG multiplier against adjacent targets by {{scaling2}}%. Randomly gains one of the following gifts:
"Straight Fire": 2 Punchline point(s) and 2 Skill point(s).
"Unreal Banger": 1 Punchline point(s).
Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.

talent.name: Sleight of Sparx Hand
talent.description_template:
While Sparxie holds "Certified Banger":
Using Enhanced Basic ATK deals {{scaling1}}% Fire Elation DMG to one designated enemy, and {{scaling2}}% Fire Elation DMG to their adjacent targets. Additionally, for every 1 instance of "Engagement Farming" triggered, the Enhanced Basic ATK deals 1 extra instance of {{scaling3}}% Fire Elation DMG to 1 random attacked enemy target.
Using Ultimate deals {{scaling4}}% Fire Elation DMG to all enemies.

ultimate.name: Party's Wildin' and Camera's Rollin'
ultimate.description_template: Gains 2 Punchline. Deals Fire DMG equal to (0.6 × Elation + {{scaling1}}%) of Sparxie's ATK to all enemies.

technique.name: Content Monetization
technique.description: After using the Technique, inflicts enemies within a set area with "Block" for 10 second(s). "Blocked" enemies cannot detect ally targets. After entering combat via actively attacking a "Blocked" enemy, deals Fire DMG to all enemies equal to 50% of Sparxie's ATK and recovers 2 Skill Point(s) for allies.

skill.name: Signal Overflow: The Great Encore!
skill.description_template: Deals {{scaling1}}% Fire Elation DMG to all enemies and deals 20 additional instance(s) of DMG. Each instance deals {{scaling2}}% Fire Elation DMG to one random enemy. Grants 2 "Thrill" point(s) to Sparxie, which can be used to offset Sparxie's Skill Point consumption. Consuming "Thrill" is considered as consuming Skill Points.

2.name: Sweet! Punchline Signing
2.description: For every 100 of Sparxie's ATK that exceeds 2000, increases this unit's Elation by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 80%.

4.name: Dazzling! Persona Kaleidoscope
4.description: When there are 1/2/(3 or more) Elation characters in the team, using Sparxie's Ultimate will additionally gain 2/4/8 Punchline and 1/1/4 "Thrill".

6.name: Frenzy! Palette of Truth and Lies
6.description: For every 1 Punchline currently owned, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 8%, up to a max increase of 80%.

eidolons.name: #GoingViral #WhoIsShe
eidolons.description: When Aha Instant ends, gains 5 Punchline. For every 1 Punchline owned, increases All-Type RES PEN for all allies by 1.5%, up to a max increase of 15%.

eidolons.name: #AudienceKnows
eidolons.description: When Aha Instant ends, Sparxie gains 1 extra turn and 2 "Thrill." For every 1 "Thrill" consumed, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 10%, lasting for 2 turn(s) and stacking up to 4 time(s).

eidolons.name: #LinkUp #HeartSkip
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: #LockedIn #FaceCard
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, additionally gains 5 Punchline and increases this unit's Elation by 36% for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: #HealingTheWorld #GoodVibesOnly
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: #BuiltDifferent #GoingExtinct
eidolons.description: Increases All-Type RES PEN by 20%. For every 1 Punchline taken into account, the number of additional DMG instances dealt by the Elation Skill increases by 1, up to a max of 40.
